objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed policy or guideline document created, edited, released, distributed, revised, archived, or reactivated in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Selected type such as policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document abbreviation used with the consecutive number.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Consecutive number assigned to the document.

attributes.name: metadata
attributes.description: Standardized and customer-specific metadata maintained in document properties.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Lifecycle or workflow status of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which validity starts after release.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from valid from and period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period after which validity must be checked.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which an invalidated document is archived.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template selected when creating a new document object.

objs.name: document_version
objs.description: Version of a document created for editing, release, revision, reactivation, or archiving history.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: State of the version such as editing, released, or out of force.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document and released or archived with it.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary object added to a document and released or published directly via properties.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created for an existing document without affecting content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document before validity expires and processed by workflow.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request created to invalidate and archive a released document.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to re-validate an invalidated document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person acting as creator, author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, reader, or initiator in document management.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System or process role assigned to the user.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Authorization or distribution group assigned to documents or users.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained per document with assigned User Groups and persons for e-mail distribution, acknowledgement, and dashboards.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants during release, validity extension, override, reactivation, or acknowledgement.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature completed by workflow participants and documented for each released version.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attach a new information object and select the corresponding document type and optional template.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Maintain standardized or customer-specific document metadata and authorization-related properties.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Edit the document content using the implemented editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert a saved document to PDF for web display.

evts.name: link_document
evts.description: Link documents in the system with processes, organizational units, risks, other documents, or master data.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add an Attachment to a document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an existing Attachment of a document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark or archive an Attachment associated with a document.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Add Additional Info to a document.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release or publish Additional Info directly via switches in properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete Additional Info directly.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Initiate the three-step release process after document creation and maintenance.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: Registered author signs the Creator workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Assigned reviewers check the document and complete review tasks.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Assigned releaser completes release task, causing the document to be released and published.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects during review or release, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish a released document so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_document_version
evts.description: Automatically create a new editing version when a valid released document is revised or when a change proposal is scheduled.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a released or validated document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Document the editing of assigned change proposals in the change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System creates a request 30 days before the valid-until date.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity, delete the request, and update the valid-until date.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension
evts.description: Automatically terminate validity extension processing when a revised version is released or override is declared.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Create a request for override for a selected released document.

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: Declare the document out of force, archive it, revoke rights except archive group, and retain the request for documentation.

evts.name: delete_edited_version
evts.description: Delete existing edited versions after override is declared.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete archived documents after the archive period expires.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation and select the corresponding invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Confirm reactivation, create a new version, restore authorizations and distribution, and reactivate archived Attachments.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Assign User Groups and persons to distribution attributes for a document.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Notify assigned users and users of assigned User Groups by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request active acknowledgement from assigned persons and User Groups upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement using a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content or documents into another language.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Check translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release translated version so it is visible in the corresponding login language.

o2o.description: A document can be created from one selected template defined for its document type.
A document is managed in versions.
Attachments are added to and associated with a main document.
Additional Info objects can supplement a document.
A Change Proposal clearly belongs to a document and is displayed in it.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document to be checked.
A request for override is created for a selected document.
A request for reactivation selects the corresponding invalidated document.
A Distribution List is maintained for a document.
Persons can be assigned directly to a Distribution List.
User Groups can be assigned to a Distribution List.
Users can be assigned to User Groups.
Users can be maintained on a document as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, reader, translator, or initiator.
Authorization groups can be assigned specifically to documents.
Signatures are documented in the system for each released version.
Documents can reference or be linked to other documents.
